name: Opportunity Youth Program, Middlesex College
what_you_do: This program provides education and job training for out-of-school youth. It offers high school equivalency prep. It also offers paid training in in-demand jobs. You do career exploration, work readiness and work experience.
who_can_apply: Out-of-school youth ages 16 to 24 who live in Middlesex County and meet additional eligibility criteria. Not for teens currently enrolled in high school.
pay_detail: Paid training and work experience are listed; the wage is not stated.
how_to_apply: Email opportunityyouthprogram@middlesexcollege.edu to start. Office: 550 Jersey Avenue, New Brunswick, Monday to Friday 8:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
notes: The page does not name the funding source. Teens under 18 who are not in school should check eligibility with the office. Paid work for people under 18 in New Jersey needs working papers (online). See permit.html?state=nj for the exact permit and steps.
